newsitem.title: UK: Stakis sees profits of 30.6 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Stakis sees profits of 30.6 mln stg.

text.p: Stakis Plc, which is raising 222 million stg via a rights issue to buy five hotels from Lonrho Plc, said it expects profits before tax and exceptional items to be not less than 30.6 million stg in the year to September 30, 1996.
The company also forecast a final dividend of 1.2 pence a share, making a total of 2.15 pence for the full year, an increase of 23 percent.
The group said returns on the acquisition were expected to be earnings enhancing from the first year.

"While both groups will learn from each other, the operational and marketing skills which Stakis has developed under its current management are expected to impact very posititively on the performance and profitabiliy of all five hotels," said chief executive David Michels.
The group is calling a meeting with analysts at 0930 GMT and plans to send a prospectus with details of the purchase and rights issue to shareholders later today.
